rows.grounds: Nominal form indicating extent or length.
Fused form treated as a single token; functions as a connective.
Subject whose prescribed length is stated.

items.question: What prescribed length in dance-measure units must the manuscript have?
premises: The manuscript is the subject whose length is prescribed.
The prescribed extent reaches thirty-two dance-measure units.
The optative verb expresses a normative requirement.
items.inference: Therefore, the manuscript should have a length extending to thirty-two dance-measure units.
uncertainties: The exact technical meaning of nṛttamātrā as a unit of measure is unclear from this verse alone.
The internal analysis of the fused token satu is uncertain.
items.plain_english: The manuscript, however, should have a length extending to thirty-two dance-measure units.
